mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UPLOADED_FILE (ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_PATH, FILE_YEAR, INSTITUTION_NAME, CATEGORY, STATUS, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{year}, #{institutionName}, #{category}, #{status}, #{uploadedAt})

SELECT UPLOADED_FILE_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO UPLOADED_FILE (ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_PATH, FILE_YEAR, INSTITUTION_NAME, CATEGORY, STATUS, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{year}, #{institutionName}, #{category}, #{status}, #{uploadedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET STORED_PATH = #{storedPath}, INSTITUTION_NAME = #{institutionName}, FILE_YEAR = #{year}, CATEGORY = #{category}, STATUS = #{status}, CLASSIFIED_AT = #{classifiedAt} WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET STATUS = 'DELETED' WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE UPLOADED_FILE SET STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME = '알수없음' AND STATUS = 'CLASSIFIED' ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE STATUS = #{status}
SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE (#{institution} = '' OR INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{institution}, '%')) AND (#{year} = '' OR FILE_YEAR = #{year}) AND (#{keyword} = '' OR ORIGINAL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM UPLOADED_FILE WHERE (#{institution} IS NULL OR INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{institution} || '%') AND (#{year} IS NULL OR FILE_YEAR = #{year}) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR ORIGINAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC
